text: dsh-deck-builder 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的演示文稿工具插件，可把 Markdown 内容转换为可直接在浏览器打开的单文件 HTML 幻灯片。它通过注册 deck_build 工具接收正文、标题、主题、输出路径和页脚，并将结果写入工作目录或指定位置。插件按水平分隔线或 H1/H2 标题拆分页面，支持 deepseek、light、dark 三种主题，以及标题、段落、列表、代码块、引用、链接和图片等 Markdown 内容渲染。生成页面内置方向键翻页、空格翻页和全屏操作。适合把报告、会议记录或课程提纲整理成可浏览的演示文稿；代码不要求 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-deck-builder converts Markdown into a self-contained HTML slide deck through a DSH Web tool. Choose slide boundaries, a theme, and an output path; the generated page supports keyboard navigation and fullscreen. It renders common Markdown content and needs no API key or external service.
想把一份 Markdown 报告快速整理成能翻页的演示文稿。
有没有办法让 DSH 根据会议记录生成浏览器里能打开的幻灯片？
我希望用几条分隔线决定 Markdown 每页幻灯片的边界。
让 DSH 把课程提纲变成带标题和主题样式的 HTML 演示。
能不能给生成的幻灯片换成浅色或深色主题？
想要一个输出单文件 HTML、无需额外素材的演示文稿工具。
I want to turn Markdown notes into a browser-ready slide deck.
Can DSH split my outline into slides and add keyboard navigation?
dsh-deck-builder 的功能「Markdown 转幻灯片」：调用 deck_build 并提供 Markdown 正文，可按分隔线或 H1/H2 标题拆成页面，返回 HTML 文件路径、页数和字节数。
dsh-deck-builder 的功能「主题化演示页面」：调用 deck_build 时选择 deepseek、light 或 dark 主题，生成页面会内嵌对应样式，并提供方向键、空格翻页和全屏操作。
dsh-deck-builder 的功能「Markdown 内容排版」：将标题、段落、列表、代码块、引用、粗体、斜体、链接和图片转换为 HTML 页面内容。

dsh-deck-builder README · dsh-deck-builder 📽️：A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** pure tool plugin that registers the `deck_build` tool, letting the agent turn any Markdown (research reports, meeting notes, course outlines…) into a single-file HTML deck the user opens directly in a browser — `←`/`→` to navigate, `f` for fullscreen, one slide per page when printing. All generation logic is **zero-dependency pure functions**, and the output is fully self-contained (inline CSS/JS, no external assets, no network).

dsh-deck-builder README · ✨ Features：- **`deck_build` tool**: `markdown` → HTML slides, returns output path / slide count / bytes.
- **Three themes**: `deepseek` / `light` / `dark`, CSS variables inlined.
- **Smart splitting**: splits on `---` / `***` / `___` rules, falling back to H1/H2 headings when no rules exist.
- **Full Markdown rendering**: headings, paragraphs, ordered/unordered lists, code blocks, blockquotes, bold/italic, inline code, links, images.
- **Zero dependencies, zero core changes**: pure `ctx.tools.register`, no client bundle, no network, no external assets.
- **Pure-function tested**: splitting / rendering / escaping / self-containment all covered by unit tests.

dsh-deck-builder README · 📦 Install：Prereqs: DSH (`dsh web` works), Node ≥ 22.19, pnpm.

```bash
dsh-deck-builder README · From GitHub (prebuilt lib/ committed)：dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Blaczz/dsh-deck-builder#main"

dsh-deck-builder README · Local directory：cd dsh-deck-builder && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-deck-builder
```

**Restart `dsh web` after install**, then ask the agent to "turn this into slides" or have it call `deck_build` directly.

dsh-deck-builder README · 🎬 Usage：In a conversation, ask the agent to build a deck:

```
Turn this research report into slides using the deepseek theme:
<markdown content>
```

The agent calls `deck_build`, producing `deck-<title>.html`. Open it and use `←`/`→` or space to navigate, `f` for fullscreen, and print/export to PDF for one-slide-per-page.

Or call the tool manually:

```json
{
  "markdown": "# Title\nbody\n\n---\n\n# Slide 2\nmore",
  "title": "My Deck",
  "theme": "deepseek",

dsh-deck-builder README · 🧩 Ecosystem positioning：- **Fills a gap**: the DSH Slides/PPT category previously had only `dsh-openmaic` (teaching) and `dsh-k12-lesson-builder`; a general "Markdown → presentation" tool was missing, even though `mdPresenter` proved the demand.
- **Technical route**: pure tool plugin (`ctx.tools.register` + `defineTool`), reusing the self-contained-HTML artifact shape of `hccccc01333/dsh-report-html`.
- **Zero core changes**: single-file output + zero-dependency pure functions + `ctx.effect` registration.
